company.name: Beam Impact
company.shortDescription: Beam is a social impact tech company that offers an app where customers can discover mission-driven brands.
company.description: Beam is a social impact tech company that provides an app that allows customers to discover mission-driven brands and make an impact while shopping through its e-commerce integration. Beam connects with partner brands that have vetted nonprofits that reflect their values and allows customers to choose a nonprofit while checking out, where the brand donates a portion of their purchase at no additional cost. Beam's mission is to create a community of conscious consumers, mission-led brands, and high-impact nonprofits in order to make impact more accessible and rewarding.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $13,300,000, or 86.22% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,575,068 to $64,533,838, a 14.11x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 63 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
